reviews_data.review_text: Food and service are great but SO MANY FLIES on the porch! If they could do something about that it would be my new favorite!
reviews_data.owner_answer:
Hi, Caroline!
Thanks for taking the time to leave us a review. We LOVE that you love our food and service, and apologize for the flies outside. Please know that we’re actively working on a solution for this and it should be resolved soon. 
Hope to see you again soon! :)

reviews_data.review_text: Great shop with a ton of space to work and study. The staff is very friendly and the coffee is great. All around would recommend to anyone looking for a great coffee shop.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thanks so much! Looking forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews_data.review_text: I love summit already but today was my first 5 stars across the board. The space has a beautiful aesthetic, with a cute little patio are & its extremely clean. It even smells clean & fresh. Plus the baristas are super sweet. I love it!
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thanks for your kind words, Lauryn! We’re so glad you love our space as much as we do!
Thanks for the review and your kind words about our staff! See you again soon! :)

reviews_data.review_text: I can't imagine this place getting anything less than 5 stars. It's absolutely perfect! Staff is friendly and coffee is always on point. One of my favorite spots to work or to take a quick break. It's in the heart of Charlotte so of course parking is what it is. I'm sure they can't control who parks on the side of the street or the construction going around them 😅 Anyways, great place with an amazing atmosphere. Cheers
reviews_data.owner_answer: Hi, Nam! Thanks for taking the time to review us! We’re so glad you enjoy our space and coffee, and appreciate your understanding regarding our parking situation. Looking forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews_data.review_text: I love the experience Abby was our barista coffee was amazing she recommended based on our likes and dislikes.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Hi, Ivy! Thank you so much for the review. Abby is the best!

reviews_data.review_text: The layout of this coffee shop is very nice. The furniture is comfortable and there's a lot of natural light.  Basecamp blend is always a hit.  Parking might be an issue.  It's best to park on the street.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Hi Joshua! Thank you so much - we're glad you enjoyed the space and coffee!

reviews_data.review_text:
Firstly no parking. Residents take all the parking spots on the street and in the lot.
Coffee had curdled cream and I had to throw it away.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Hi Kat! Being in the Wilmore/South End area, parking tends to be tight - especially with the construction! We're super thankful that all the street parking is free though, but we totally understand the frustration. We do apologize for the coffee though! We would have been happy to remake it for you - but hope you can join us another time!
